narrative.overview: Clothly Ecommerce is a curated fashion experience built around warmth, restraint, and intentional choices.
keyCharacteristics: Balanced typographic hierarchy using Geist sans

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent amber is reserved exclusively for focal actions and deliberate highlights.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Card containment and section boundaries are defined by subtle 1px borders.

dos: Do maintain a minimum text contrast ratio of 4.5:1 on all body elements.
Do use text-wrap: balance on headers and text-wrap: pretty on prose.
Do keep display letter-spacing at or above -0.04em.
donts: Don't add fast-fashion urgency elements such as countdown timers or neon sale badges.
Don't use gradient text or side-stripe border accents on cards.
Don't use generic AI-minimal SaaS-cream templates.
